title: Background
description: A background represents a character's prior life, training, or origin. Backgrounds are chosen at character creation and grant a package of starting skill bonuses, equipment, spells, and minor features. They provide flavorful competence and concrete starting gear without consuming the character's normal level-1 skill point pool or tag choices.

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

category.description: Loose organizational tag for grouping on sheets and in UIs (e.g. wilderness, military, arcane, criminal, noble, scholarly, religious, merchant)

skill_bonuses.description: One-time flat bonuses added to the normal skill base (5 + associatedAbility × 2) at character creation. These do not count against the level-1 skill point pool and do not affect tag skill ratios.

skill.description: Skill id (numeric) or key from skills/core.json

bonus.description: Flat ranks added to the skill at creation (typical useful range 8-15)

starting_equipment.description: Items granted at creation. Prefer namespaced equipment refs (core:weapons/shortsword, core:armors/leather_jerkin, core:consumables/potion_minor_healing). Legacy numeric ids are still accepted during transition. Quantities default to 1 if omitted.

item.description: Equipment reference: preferred format core:<category>/<key> (e.g. core:weapons/shortsword); legacy numeric id or bare key also accepted

starting_spells.description: Spells the character begins knowing. These are granted regardless of current skill level (though casting them effectively still requires investment in the governing <color>_magic skill). References spells/core.json by id.

granted_features.description: Features (perks) granted automatically by this background. Typically universal or low-prerequisite entries from features/core.json. These are in addition to any chosen creation perks or racial traits.

wealth_bonus.description: Extra starting gold (in gp) granted by this background, added to the normal campaign starting wealth (recommended baseline 100 gp).

suggested_tag_skills.description: Skills this background naturally pairs well with for tag skill selection. Purely advisory; does not mechanically force or grant tags.
